card.title: Keep Hope Operational
card.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The model cloud produced one drop. Let's build the welcome tray.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That doesn't prove the full rain machine works.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It proves the tray has a purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put the small success where we can still see it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cloud lifted a raindrop back into the sky. Let's prepare the full demonstration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If I reverse a whole shower, Dad says he'll fund the workshop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've filmed the first drop. I'll mark out the paving for the shower.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Shall I send him the capacity report too? You read it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just the film for now. I'll borrow floodlights; he should see every drop going home.

mechanism: A must support B's hope of impossible success through useful evidence and action while withholding known discouraging facts.
confusable: Unlike ordinary encouragement, the dialogue must make selective withholding of adverse knowledge discernible.
comparison: The saved funding demonstration differs from protected D159-a's visitor preparation; its legacy writer/reviewer disagreement is retained.
